load_asset — DRIVE world op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.load_asset(name: 'str', dims=None, *, root=None, paint=None) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import driveworld; driveworld.load_asset(name: 'str', dims=None, *, root=None, paint=None) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("load_asset"))

Usage

Loads a bundled asset as a mesh dict: {"V", "F", "color", "label", "name", "dims"}.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

z-up に直し、箱の寸法を dims(既定 = ASSETS の実寸)に軸ごとに合わせ、原点を箱の底面中心に置く。未知の名前・寸法 ≤ 0 は ValueError。同じ名前は 1 度だけ読む(キャッシュ)。

paint: 車の車体色(CAR_PAINTS の名前か (r, g, b)、None = 元の色)。車体の面だけを塗り替え、ガラス・タイヤ・灯火は元のまま、テクスチャの濃淡(明るさの比)は保つ。パトカー・タクシー(塗装が意味を持つ)と車以外は ValueError。
